volume.policy: Volume-derived features such as RVOL and OBV must respect ticker-level volume_factor_status.

historical_universe.reason: Current bootstrap is based on current governed identities. Active+delisted provider inventory workflow exists but EODHD_API_TOKEN is not configured in GitHub, so delisted historical membership and historical PEA windows remain unverified.

consensus_and_targets.reason: Audit73 validates append-only capture and strict PIT gates, but its workflow restores/saves no real source-history artifact and the expected source-cache file is not versioned.

fundamentals_and_catalysts.reason: No sufficiently documented point-in-time publication/availability series was found for fundamentals, earnings surprises, guidance or catalysts across 2010-2026.

conditions: Use only observations available on or before signal timestamp.
Exclude 731 OHLC quarantine rows and windows crossing them when required by an indicator.
Respect warm-up history for long-window indicators.
Respect ticker-level volume-factor status for RVOL/OBV/volume acceleration.

certification_policy.CERTIFIED: Reproducible evidence and point-in-time validity established.
certification_policy.USABLE_WITH_LIMITATION: Can be used only with explicit quality flags or scope limits.
certification_policy.EXCLUDED: Must not be used for historical model fitting until evidence is supplied.
